title: Contract Administration Standard: Expiration Notices for Small Business Electricity Supply Agreements
content:
## Standard

1. Every Small Business Electricity Supply agreement with a term receives two expiration notices: an initial renewal notice and a final options notice.
2. Business renewal notices are issued only on an active agreement with a term, as shown by the agreement record's status.
3. The initial renewal notice is compliant when its notice date falls no earlier than the plan's earliest initial-notice point and no later than its latest initial-notice point before the contract end date, that is no earlier than 90 and no later than 60 calendar days before the contract end date on every plan.
4. The final options notice is compliant when its notice date falls no later than the plan's latest final-notice point before the contract end date, 30 calendar days on every plan, and after the initial notice.
5. Business notices are delivered by email.
6. The following clause is **no longer in force**: "Each notice states the plan offered for renewal, the renewal rate, whether the term renews automatically, the opt-out deadline and the month-to-month rate; when the two notices differ, the final options notice governs." It has been superseded and is not applied.

## Compliance on a hypothetical contract end date of 31 December

| Notice | Notice date | Days before contract end | Compliant |
|---|---|---|---|
| Initial renewal notice | 1 October | 91 | no (earlier than 90 days) |
| Initial renewal notice | 2 October | 90 | yes |
| Initial renewal notice | 1 November | 60 | yes |
| Initial renewal notice | 2 November | 59 | no (later than 60 days) |
| Final options notice (initial notice issued 15 October) | 1 December | 30 | yes |
| Final options notice (initial notice issued 15 October) | 2 December | 29 | no (later than 30 days) |

## Statuses on which notices are issued

| Agreement | Renewal notices issued |
|---|---|
| active, with a term | yes |
| active, month-to-month | no |
| drop pending, closed, enrollment pending | no |

superseded_clauses: Each notice states the plan offered for renewal, the renewal rate, whether the term renews automatically, the opt-out deadline and the month-to-month rate; when the two notices differ, the final_options_notice governs.
